title: Blessed Elegant Letter
wikitext:
The '''Blessed Elegant Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Blessed Elegant Letter (quest)|Blessed Elegant Letter|race=HighElf|class=priest}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Blessings of the Sun,

I am pleased to learn that another devotee of faith has joined our cause. Many of our people were not previously eager to embrace the Light, even before the Scourge's attack. Some believers even abandoned their faith after the loss of our homeland.

Nonetheless, the Light's smallest glimmer shines even in the darkest cave. Thus, you and I are tasked with guiding our people back to their faith and helping them through these times of adversity. Though the Sunwell is gone, the Sun continues to shine brightly. Don't forget we are here to aid, heal, and support our people, which is precisely what they need now. If you seek my guidance or instruction, you shall locate me on the lower level of the main building.
}}

==Patch changes==
